meta.description: Master configuration for all 7 World Engine forges

journey.unconscious: Person floating, ungrounded, chaotic environment, no foundation, red energy scattered and weak.
journey.awakening: Feet touching earth, roots beginning to grow, red energy stabilizing, first structures being built.
journey.conscious: Warrior stance on solid ground, deep roots into earth, red energy strong and grounded, fortress of systems around them.

world_engine.problem: Global instability - housing crisis, food insecurity, infrastructure decay. Billions lack stable foundation. Systems fail those who need them most.
world_engine.shift: Foundation builders emerge - sustainable systems, resilient communities, local solutions. People reclaiming control over basic needs.
world_engine.vision: Vision of grounded world - everyone has foundation, systems serve humans. Abundance replaces scarcity. Stability is the new normal.

journey.unconscious: Empty studio, broken tools, person staring at blank canvas, orange energy blocked and stagnant.
journey.awakening: Sparks flying, hands in motion, orange energy swirling around half-finished creations, excitement building.
journey.conscious: Master creator surrounded by completed works, orange fire flowing freely, building new worlds with each gesture.

world_engine.problem: The creativity crisis - soul-crushing jobs, art devaluation, maker suppression. Billions of creators stuck in cubicles, dreams deferred.
world_engine.shift: Creator revolution - maker movement, AI-augmented creation, indie renaissance. Tools democratized, barriers removed.
world_engine.vision: Vision of creator world - everyone making, building, expressing. Creative economy replaces industrial. Joy in work returns.

journey.unconscious: Person hunched, yellow energy depleted, surrounded by debt and scarcity mindset.
journey.awakening: Standing taller, yellow fire igniting in core, first wealth creation, power returning.
journey.conscious: Standing in abundance, yellow sun radiating from center, wealth flowing freely to and from.

world_engine.problem: Wealth crisis - debt slavery, wealth inequality, financial illiteracy. System designed to extract, not empower.
world_engine.shift: Sovereignty movement - crypto, financial education, alternative systems. People reclaiming economic power.
world_engine.vision: Vision of abundant world - wealth flows, poverty eliminated, everyone sovereign. Money serves consciousness, not controls it.

journey.unconscious: Heart armored and closed, green energy dim, isolated behind walls, fear of connection.
journey.awakening: Armor cracking, green light emerging, first acts of protection and care, walls becoming bridges.
journey.conscious: Open heart radiating green light, shield in hand protecting others, standing for justice with love.

world_engine.problem: Protection crisis - family courts broken, children at risk, justice system failures. Vulnerable left defenseless.
world_engine.shift: Guardians rising - advocates, reformers, protectors organizing. New systems of accountability emerging.
world_engine.vision: Vision of protected world - families intact, justice real, vulnerable defended. Love in action, not just words.

journey.unconscious: Person with mouth sewn shut, blue energy trapped in throat, surrounded by noise and static.
journey.awakening: Throat glowing, first words emerging as visible blue waves, learning to speak truth.
journey.conscious: Voice resonating clearly, blue signal broadcasting to many, communication creating bridges.

world_engine.problem: Communication breakdown - propaganda, censorship, noise overwhelming signal. Truth buried under lies.
world_engine.shift: Truth resurgence - independent media, whistleblowers, authentic voices. Signal cutting through noise.
world_engine.vision: Vision of clear signal - truth flows freely, voices heard, real connection. Manipulation obsolete through transparency.

journey.unconscious: Third eye closed, person manipulated by puppet strings they can't see, indigo energy blocked.
journey.awakening: Third eye cracking open, beginning to see the strings, indigo light revealing patterns.
journey.conscious: Third eye fully open, all patterns visible, manipulation immunity complete, seer of truth.

world_engine.problem: Manipulation pandemic - propaganda, dark patterns, psychological warfare. Entire populations controlled through invisible strings.
world_engine.shift: Pattern awakening - manipulation literacy, critical thinking revival. Eyes opening to the game.
world_engine.vision: Vision of seeing world - everyone pattern-literate, manipulation obsolete. Consciousness immune to control.

journey.unconscious: Person trapped in grey box, disconnected from universe, stars invisible behind thick fog, isolated and alone.
journey.awakening: Cracks of violet light breaking through fog, person looking up as stars begin to appear, third eye glowing faintly.
journey.conscious: Person standing in infinite cosmos, connected to all things, violet energy flowing through crown, universe reflected in their being.

world_engine.problem: Global consciousness crisis - disconnection, materialism, spiritual void. Humanity lost in illusion of separation.
world_engine.shift: Awakening wave - meditation apps, psychedelic research, consciousness studies. Return to source accelerating.
world_engine.vision: Vision of planetary consciousness - unified field, collective evolution. Humanity remembers it is ONE.
